🌺 A Few Things to Remember

  • Minimum participation: A category will be performed only if the minimum required number of participants register for that category.
  • Activities marked 20 / 21 October will be scheduled on one of those two days. Final dates and performance slots will be communicated by the organizing team.
  • Children and adult categories are listed separately. Please choose the appropriate category for each participant or group.
  • Use the Register Now button under any category to open the Cultural Day registration form.
